decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block references from the affected FAQ descriptions and updates the revenue split; no additional edit is required.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully replaces the combined Small and Big Block ticket award with one Small Block ticket.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Joseph, id like to eliminate the big blocks and give that extra $1 to me, so it'll be:
$15 buy, $5 to me,  $5 to affiliate,  $5 to block prize pool.

Increases my bottom line with minimal impact on sales.
Plus it simplifies the game mechanics and marketing.

Giveing myself and each community member an even split, as well as everyone getting an even shot at the never ending $500 prizes seems aligned with the projects ethos.

decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block eligibility and reset rules, retains the operational removal fact, and narrows the ticket contexts to Small Block.
The existing same-message MODIFY fully records the $5 primary-mint allocation and identifies the Small Block pool as the sole active prize pool.
The existing same-message MODIFY already limits eligible winners to holders of current Small Block tickets; the VRF and ticket-weighting rules remain unchanged.
Eliminating Big Block does not change the existing Small Block rule of one $500 prize every 100 sales.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket counter while preserving the Small Block counter and other metadata.
The Big Block removal does not alter the NFT mint number's role, permanence, or display locations as a referral code.
The revenue and Big Block decision does not change any referral badge threshold or award condition.
The remaining Small Block prizes continue to use the established automatic payout and notification workflow; no claim-state attribute refers specifically to Big Block.
